name: agent-share-wasm
description: The Rust client, compiled to wasm. Loaded once per document in the browser; imported directly by the npx receiver.
//: Two entries for two worlds. `.` is TypeScript source and workspace-only: `agent-share-web` reaches it through the bundler, and it stays out of the tarball because it imports the generated `path.ts`, which holds the content hash of whichever machine last built the wasm.
`./node` is the published surface — the CommonJS glue wasm-bindgen writes into `node/`, beside the `.wasm` it reads from `__dirname` and the package.json marking that directory CommonJS.

Both are generated by `scripts/build-wasm.ts` and gitignored, so `files` is what puts `node/` in the tarball and `prepack` is what makes it exist first — `prepack` rather than `prepublishOnly` because it also fires for `npm pack`, which would otherwise produce a tarball with an empty `node/`.
